Why Quick

Why Merchants Choose Quick

We're not just another payment option. We're a smarter, fairer alternative designed for modern merchants.

Talk to us

Flat-Fee Pricing

Predictable. Transparent. Fair. Pay a simple flat fee per transaction, ideal for sales over £250.

QR-First, In-Store Focus

Built for face-to-face business. Your customer simply scans a dynamic QR code to pay.

QR-First, Omni-channel support

Secure, instant and flexible across all channels: in-store, online, and via payment links.

Merchant-First Setup

No upfront cost and no monthly subscription. Just plug in and start accepting payments.

No Cards, No Card Networks

Bypass Visa and Mastercard by connecting directly to bank accounts through Pay by Bank.

Optional Consumer Protection

Offer insurance-backed protection to increase confidence and peace of mind at checkout.

Loyalty Integration

Turn payments into repeat business with cashback or loyalty points every time customers use Quick.
